anika: Quick score snapshot for LiteBench bring-up. New 11B-lite model (Luna11) quantified at int6 and int8. Need product/GTN recs — routing, holdback %, and rollout plan.

ben: Can you drop unit-econ numbers? cost per 1M tokens, p95 latency, and any slice deltas?

anika: putting compact numbers here — these are from yesterday's sliced runs on prod-like traffic.

```
Model: Luna11
fp16 (baseline): cost=$120 / 1M toks, p95=210ms, pass_rate=0.912
int8: cost=$52 / 1M toks, p95=195ms, pass_rate=0.901  (∆ -1.1% vs fp16)
int6: cost=$28 / 1M toks, p95=230ms, pass_rate=0.884  (∆ -2.8% vs fp16)
```

carmen: What about the longform / retrieval slice? last time low-bit had bigger hallucination deltas there.

anika: Good call. Longform-retrieval slice metrics: int8 F1 down 1.2pp absolute, int6 down 4.5pp absolute. Short convo/top1 ranking slice: int8 down ~0.6pp, int6 down ~1.9pp. So quality impact is slice-dependent.

deploy-bot: canary deployed: us-west-2, 5% -> int6, 5% -> int8 yesterday at 03:12 UTC; no alerts, CPU/GPU mem OK.

david: GTN wants a clear recommendation: what to route to int6 vs int8 vs keep fp16? and suggested holdback percentages for a conservative rollout.

anika: My recommendation (concise):
- Core search/autocomplete / any low-latency user-facing ranking: route to int8 with fp16 fallback on low-confidence responses. Int8 gives ~57% cost reduction with ~1% quality hit — good sweet spot.
- Background batch tasks, offline summaries, embedding-heavy transfers: int6 is acceptable for cost-savings (2.6x cost reduction vs fp16) but expect ~2.5–4.5pp quality regressions on fragile retrieval slices.
- Holdback/rollout plan: start with 10% of prod for int6 (2d observation), 20% int8. If signal-stability (pass_rate drop <=1.5pp overall and hallucination delta <=2.5pp for key slices) then expand to 30–40% int8 and 25% int6 over 1 week.
- Runtime knobs: enable prefix KV caching, adaptive batching (max_batch=64, flush_ms=8) to offset p95 increase for int6.
- Gate: automatic rollback if hallucination delta >3pp on monitored longform retrieval slice or if p95 increases >40% for core routes.

ben: :thumbsup: can ops/eng-infra add a one-click rollback and an opt-out flag per route?

deploy-bot: rollout flag added: `luna11_quant_rollout`. Canary dashboard: <https://redwood.internal/reports/luna11-litebench|Luna11 litebench report>.

anika: I'll prepare a 1-page scorecard for GTN + product: key numbers, slice deltas, recommended routing table, rollout steps, and rollback thresholds. Handoff ETA: EOD.

david: Perfect — GTN wants the short doc + suggested announcement copy. Thanks team. :pray:

anika: Will do. Attaching quickpoints in thread, will DM the doc link when ready.
